definition.$comment: The indoor party's band (trumpet), owner's ruling 2026-11-07; front sheet approved the same day. Drawn at an angle, playing toward the crowd, from the front_3q view. The instrument is a mask-only garment, and Qwen draws it from the sheet. Plan: plan/levels/indoor-band-2026-11-07.md.
